manual.resonanz_observer.line1: A song we all dance to, ...
manual.resonanz_observer.line3: There is a curiosity about this world, not easily described. It appears as if any machine and living being simply stops moving when no one is close enough to perceive it.{0}
manual.resonanz_observer.line4: But no engineer can afford to waste their time standing next to the machine to keep it running - so an artificial observer shall do so instead!{0}
manual.resonanz_observer.line6: The resonanz observer relies on the strange qualities of echo shards and the highly sensitive sculk sensor to keep an area of approximately §o{0} blocks§r around it active and working, even if no one is nearby.{1}
manual.resonanz_observer.line7: To operate, the observer needs energy, input through the port on the §lright side§r of the structure.{0}
manual.resonanz_observer.line8: To protocol its observations, it also requires a supply of §2paper§r, fed in through the port on the §lleft side§r.{0}
manual.resonanz_observer.line9: Applying a redstone signal to the control panel at the front will disable the machine, this behavior can be inverted by use of the Engineer's Screwdriver.{0}
manual.resonanz_observer.line10: Interacting with the machine will bring up its interface.{0}
manual.resonanz_observer.line11: The readout on the left shows all the blocks which the observer is keeping active.
manual.resonanz_observer.line12: Clicking an entry in the list will send out some vibration to indicate the blocks.{0}
manual.resonanz_observer.line13: §2Paper§r can also be input here, with the remaining duration displayed next to the slot.
manual.resonanz_observer.line14: A single piece of paper lasts for §o{0} seconds§r of recording.
